title: Understanding the Table
text: The table shows bootstrap replicates of the sample. Each row represents a different bootstrap sample, and the columns represent the values in each sample. The rowmeans, rowvars, and rowmedians are the means, variances, and medians of each row, respectively.

title: Identifying the Sampling Distribution
text: The sampling distribution of a statistic is the distribution of that statistic over many samples. In this case, you need to identify the distribution of the sample median from the bootstrap replicates.

title: Analyzing Row Medians
text: Look at the rowmedians in the table. What are the values?

title: Choosing the Correct Plot
text: The correct plot will show the distribution of the sample medians from the bootstrap replicates. Compare the rowmedians and colmedians to the plots provided.
